jobs.title: Senior UX Strategist & Researcher (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh is going AI-first. Join us in leading the shift and shaping the global customer experience. As a Senior UX Strategist & Researcher on our UX team, you'll own work from ambiguous brief to strategic outcome and implementation — defining project needs, using innovative research approaches, prototyping direction instead of presenting findings, and walking into executive meetings with a decision artifact, not a summary. The most valued teammates today aren't the ones who run the most studies. They shape which questions get asked, challenge business assumptions before money is spent, and stay in the room to drive the decision. 

You'll use AI fluently as a genuine creative and strategic partner throughout the product design lifecycle. Strategy and research are your deepest strengths, but you’ll also work across the wider UX practice. We’re looking for people who go deep in one area and can take interface design, service design, and content to a solid minimum quality standard on their own, using AI to move fast, and who know when a problem needs a specialist’s depth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

jobs.title: Senior Safety & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief

We deliver the half of the rocket that stays on the ground. As Senior Specialist, you will be responsible for end-to-end safety & compliance of the company’s ground infrastructure systems according to location and system specific standards. This includes direct and indirect technical involvement in safety & risk assessment processes, as well as component selection and safety system implementations. You are acting as technical lead, also serving in an interfacing function between the different ground system disciplines i.e. fluid, control and mechanical systems.

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

  • Own and drive safety and compliance activities for all ground infrastructure systems, ensuring adherence to site‑specific, national, and international standards
  • Drive HAZOPs, risk assessments, and safety reviews across multiple projects, ensuring risks are identified, documented, and mitigated effectively
  • Guide the design, selection, and validation of safety‑critical components, including safety valves, instrumentation, and protective systems and safety PLC-based architectures
  • Define safety processes, documentation standards, and best practices, ensuring consistent application across all ground systems projects
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, operations, and project teams to ensure safety considerations are integrated early and consistently throughout the project lifecycle

jobs.description:
Localization Operations Specialist (Contractor)

Level: Mid-level contractor
Team: Localization
Location: London / Remote or Hybrid

The role

OpenTable’s Localization team helps make our products, content and customer experiences work naturally across global markets. As a Localization Operations Specialist, you will support the daily localization operation end to end, making sure content moves smoothly from intake to delivery, issues are resolved quickly and workflows continue to improve as we scale internationally.

 

This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who can move comfortably between project coordination, localization technology, integrations, strings management and troubleshooting. You will work with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, CRM, Support, external language partners and other teams across OpenTable.

 

You will:

 

  • Manage localization requests from scoping and preparation through translation, review, QA and delivery.
  • Coordinate priorities, deadlines, dependencies, stakeholders and external language resources.
  • Operate and improve localization workflows across tools and integrations, including systems such as Figma, Braze and similar platforms.
  • Investigate issues such as missing strings, failed syncs, incorrect statuses, formatting problems, placeholders and duplicate content.

jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
